# OneTake

> macOS CLI and stdio MCP server for repeatable physical-iPhone demos using XCUITest, YAML and OBS.

Experimental, source-only installation under the MIT license. Requires Node 22.x >=22.18. Real operation requires macOS, Xcode, Apple development signing and an authorized USB-connected iPhone. `take validate` is offline; `take run --dry` performs real actions without recording. Protocol schema IDs remain `contrarregra.*/1` for compatibility.

## Start here

- [Overview](README.md): Product scope, quick start and limits.
- [Portuguese overview](README.pt.md): Complete Brazilian Portuguese translation of the README; detailed guides remain in English.
- [Installation](docs/installation.md): Local dependencies, signing, configuration and OBS.
- [Usage](docs/usage.md): Validate a script, rehearse, record and handle pauses.
- [CLI reference](docs/cli.md): Commands actually registered, flags and exit codes.
- [Example choreography](examples/first-take.choreo.yaml): Generic template, not a bundled application.
